Detail holds only the General Fund departmental schedule (p8, total revenues 146,176 = General column). The Street column has no schedule in the trim; its only revenue row is Intergovernmental 67,842 (Street total revenues 67,842). 146,176 + 67,842 = 214,018 = statement total.

gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund column: the Street column on p3 prints Transfers in 38,477 and Transfers out (833); neither is in detail, so both are added here (the transfers out line has no gap row of its own because the statement Total column prints no transfers out). (2) Different basis: the statement Total Governmental Funds column nets the transfers through its Reclassifications column: Street 38,477 - reclassification 35,811 = 2,666. Detail records transfers gross and at department level: the p8 General Fund departmental schedule prints transfers in General 8,885 + Social Security 7,231 + Unemployment 800 = 16,916, which are transfers between General Fund departments (the General column on p3 prints no transfers in; its net (34,978) = 16,916 - 51,894 department transfers out). After the additions the transfers-in lines are 16,916 + 38,477 = 55,393 vs statement 2,666; the remaining 52,727 = 16,916 inter-department + 35,811 reclassification is presentation (gross vs netted), not an error.
